verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents connecting to your ticketing system to ingest data and take action, and says it works alongside existing tools without migration. Release notes describe human handoff inside the same platform, which suggests a standalone mode. However, the evidence never names Zendesk, Salesforce or Intercom, never says the agent runs embedded inside those helpdesks, and never describes two-way ticket and context sync. Missing for 10: named Zendesk/Salesforce/Intercom integrations, explicit evidence of the agent running inside the helpdesk, documented bidirectional ticket/context sync, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the agent runs inside my existing helpdesk — Zendesk, Salesforce, Intercom — or standalone, syncing tickets and context both ways

citations.quote: Connect Lorikeet in seconds to your ticketing system, knowledge base, and internal tools to seamlessly ingest data and take action for your customers
No migration required: Lorikeet works alongside your existing tools.
When the AI concierge can't resolve a conversation, a human agent steps in directly inside the same platform
Build your customer Concierge to take actions inside the tools your team already uses
